form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Kennedy introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To reauthorize the National Flood Insurance Program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the National Flood Insurance Program Extension Act.

section.header: Reauthorization of National Flood Insurance Program

subsection.text: Section 1309(a) of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4016(a)) is amended by striking May 31, 2019 and inserting December 1, 2020.
Section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4026) is amended by striking May 31, 2019 and inserting December 1, 2020.
If this Act is enacted after May 31, 2019, the amendments made by subsections (a) and (b) shall take effect as if enacted on May 31, 2019.
